judgments.reason: The HBN-EEG preprint by the dataset's own authors (Shirazi, Franco, Hoffmann, Esper, Truong) describes the BIDS/HED-formatted HBN-EEG releases, including this Release 4.
judgments.paper_title: HBN-EEG: The FAIR implementation of the Healthy Brain Network (HBN) electroencephalography dataset

judgments.reason: Alexander et al. 2017 describes the overall Healthy Brain Network initiative and biobank, of which this HBN-EEG Release 4 is one part, not this dataset's own data paper.
judgments.paper_title: An open resource for transdiagnostic research in pediatric mental health and learning disorders

judgments.reason: Langer et al. 2017 describes the earlier 126-participant EEG/eye-tracking resource from the HBN initiative, not this Release 4 dataset; it is the HBN umbrella/precursor paper.
judgments.paper_title: A resource for assessing information processing in the developing brain using EEG and eye tracking
